description: This file defines the GeoIp2Migration class responsible for migrating geographic IP data rules within the RV\Upgrade namespace. It includes constants for rule types, country subdivision mappings, and methods for migrating and translating geographic regions based on country and region codes.

classes.name: GeoIp2Migration
classes.description: Class for migrating geographic IP rules, including mapping country subdivisions and handling different rule types.

methods.name: migrate
methods.description: Main method to migrate a rule based on its type, dispatching to specific migration methods.

methods.name: migrateRegionRule
methods.description: Handles migration of region-based rules, translating region codes to subdivisions.

methods.name: migrateDmaRule
methods.description: Handles migration of Dma rules, converting them to US Metro type.

methods.name: migrateNetSpeedRule
methods.description: Handles migration of Netspeed rules, converting them to ConnectionType.

methods.name: regionTranslate
methods.description: Translates region codes into subdivision identifiers, handling switches and warnings.

methods.name: regionCompact
methods.description: Compacts a list of regions into a string, ensuring uniqueness and sorted order.
